text.p: Norway's Bjorn Daehlie regained his command of World Cup Nordic skiing when he won a 15-km classic free-style race on Saturday.
Daehlie beat Italy's Fulvio Valbus to the finish line with a time of 35 minutes and 49.5 seconds just a week after placing a disappointing 18th in a 10-km World Cup race in Davos, Switzerland.
Valbus finished 39.4 seconds behind Daehlie. Kirsten Skejldal, also of Norway, was third in 36 minutes and 33.3 seconds.
"There's nothing to be done against Daehlie," Valbus said after the race. "He's going really strong."
In the women's 15-km classic, Italy's Stefania Belmondo crossed the line ahead of Elena Vaelbe of Russia by just over a second. Third place went to Nina Gavriliuk, also of Russia.
The finish was an exact repeat of the women's 10-km race in Davos on December 7, when Belmondo collected a World Cup victory by also finishing ahead of Vaelbe and Gavriliuk.
"I am in very good shape thanks to the all the training I have done," Belmondo said.
